# Pritesh Rathod

> Python Backend Developer specializing in FastAPI, LangChain, and LangGraph. Building scalable backend systems and AI/LLM-powered applications.

Pritesh Rathod is a backend developer based in Ahmedabad, India, pursuing an M.Sc. in Computer Applications & Information Technology at Gujarat University. His recent work focuses on RAG pipelines, LLM-powered applications, and AI platforms such as Zentriom.

## Projects

- [AI Voice Assistant](https://github.com/rathod-pritesh/ai-voice-assistant): Web-based AI voice assistant built with SvelteKit and FastAPI, using NLP (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) and the Web Speech API
- [BuildTrack](https://github.com/rathod-pritesh/BuildTrack-construction-management-system): Role-based construction management system (Flask, MySQL, Bootstrap) covering planning, attendance, and cost estimation
- [Netflix Watchlist API](https://github.com/rathod-pritesh/go-mongodb-crud-api): RESTful API in Go and MongoDB with CRUD operations and MVC-style architecture
- [Medical RAG Chatbot](https://github.com/rathod-pritesh/end-to-end-medical-chatbot-generative-ai): AI medical chatbot using RAG, Pinecone vector search, and Groq/LLaMA 3
